_how_to_edit: Two sections: stocks & ETFs, and crypto. Inside each, brokers are shown in alphabetical order. To use an affiliate link: replace 'url' with the link the affiliate program gives you and set 'affiliate' to true (that shows the Affiliate tag). Keep 'url' pointing at the stock/ETF or spot crypto account, never CFDs, futures or margin. Only list crypto platforms with an EU MiCA licence (check the ESMA register). Update 'checked' whenever you re-check the facts. Broker ids must be unique across both sections.

sections.title: Best for stocks & ETFs
sections.intro: Regulated brokers for buying shares and ETFs. Use these for the stock strategies in this app.

brokers.name: Directa
brokers.fees: Italian shares about €5 flat, or 0.19% (min €1.50, max €18). US shares $9. Many ETFs €0 on orders from €1,000.
brokers.tax_text: You choose: Directa pays the taxes for you (amministrato) or you declare them (dichiarativo).
brokers.good_to_know: Italian broker. Real-time quotes cost extra; delayed quotes are free.

brokers.name: Fineco
brokers.fees: Italian shares and ETFs €2.95–€19 per order, US shares $3.95–$12.95, cheaper the more you trade each month.
brokers.tax_text: Fineco works out and pays the taxes for you (amministrato).
brokers.good_to_know: Italian bank, so the current account, cards and investing sit in one place. Check which account type you open, as fees differ.

brokers.name: Scalable Capital
brokers.fees: €0.99 per order on the free plan. With PRIME+ (€4.99/month), €0 on orders over €250.
brokers.tax_text: Since September 2026 Scalable pays the taxes for you by default (amministrato); you can switch to dichiarativo.
brokers.regulator: BaFin and Bundesbank (Germany), Banca d'Italia for the Italian branch
brokers.good_to_know: German bank with a Milan branch and an Italian IBAN for new clients. Free ETF savings plans from €1.

brokers.name: Trading 212
brokers.fees: €0 commission on stocks and ETFs. 0.15% currency fee when you buy something not priced in euros.
brokers.tax_text: You declare and pay the taxes yourself (dichiarativo, quadri RT and RW).
brokers.good_to_know: Open the Invest account, not the CFD account. Fractional shares from €1.

sections.title: Best for crypto
sections.intro: Exchanges with an EU MiCA licence, which every platform serving Italy has needed since July 2026. Use these for the crypto strategies in this app.

brokers.name: Bitpanda
brokers.fees: 0%–2.49% per trade depending on the coin and how you pay, mostly built into the price you see.
brokers.tax_text: You declare and pay the taxes yourself (quadri RT and RW).
brokers.good_to_know: European platform with a simple app. Also offers fractional stocks, ETFs and precious metals.

brokers.name: Coinbase
brokers.fees: Simple buys cost around 1.5% or more. Advanced Trade is much cheaper, and its fees fall as your monthly volume grows.
brokers.tax_text: You declare and pay the taxes yourself (quadri RT and RW).
brokers.good_to_know: Easiest to start with. Use Advanced Trade to keep fees down; paying by card costs about 4%, bank transfer is free.

brokers.name: Conio
brokers.fees: Charged as a margin on each buy and sell; see Conio's price list.
brokers.tax_text: Ask Conio whether it pays the taxes for you; otherwise you declare them yourself (quadri RT and RW).
brokers.regulator: CONSOB and Banca d'Italia (Italy), MiCA licence
brokers.good_to_know: Italian, Bitcoin-first app. Also behind the crypto offer in some Italian banks' apps.

brokers.name: Cryptosmart
brokers.fees: Charged on each trade; see Cryptosmart's price list.
brokers.tax_text: Pays the taxes for you (amministrato), free since April 2026, including the 0.2% yearly tax on holdings.
brokers.regulator: CONSOB and Banca d'Italia (Italy), MiCA licence
brokers.good_to_know: Italian. The first exchange in Italy to handle crypto taxes as sostituto d'imposta.

brokers.name: Kraken
brokers.fees: Kraken Pro from 0.40% (maker) and 0.80% (taker) at the lowest volume tier. Instant Buy costs more.
brokers.tax_text: You declare and pay the taxes yourself (quadri RT and RW).
brokers.regulator: Ireland (Central Bank of Ireland), MiCA licence
brokers.good_to_know: Cheapest of the big exchanges if you use Kraken Pro. Skip the futures and margin sections.

brokers.name: Young Platform
brokers.fees: Charged as a spread on each buy and sell, lower in the Pro app; see Young Platform's price list.
brokers.tax_text: You declare and pay the taxes yourself; the app offers a tax report to help.
brokers.regulator: CONSOB and Banca d'Italia (Italy), MiCA licence
brokers.good_to_know: Italian (Turin). App in Italian, made for beginners.
